name: authoring-connector-choice-prod-default
description: Connector choice with a production default: two mail connectors on the same base URL, one dev and one prod. When generation aborts with a connector_choice need, author_workflow does not retry or guess: it returns requires_user_input with a prefilled ask_user_choice whose default is the prod connector (chosen by environment, not by name order) and whose options list both. One generation pass, draft unchanged, no live HTTP.
failure_class: generator cannot tell which of several mail connectors is production

input.goal: Send the weekly status report by mail every Monday.

abort.reason: two mail connectors could send this report

needs.question: Which mail connector should send the weekly report?
